subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank refers to the idea expressed by Adi Shankaracharya, stating that the world and life are myths that change. The correct word should reflect the nature of the world he describes.
 
• The term "unreal" appropriately captures the concept of an illusory or mythical world as described in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"‘*What he said is that it is from one unreal world to another **unreal **world.*"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"confused" – This does not align with the abstract and philosophical nature of the passage.
 
• **Option 2: **"reality" – While it fits grammatically, it contradicts the description of the world as mythical and changing.
 
• **Option 4: **"unimaginary" – This is not a standard English word and does not fit the context.
